row so each enrichment is auditable. Return the full enriched table.

import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Connect to the SQLite database
conn = sqlite3.connect('enrichment.db')

# Execute the per-row enrichment query
query = """
SELECT 
    base_data.*,
    enrichment_data.additional_info,
    enrichment_data.score,
    enrichment_data.category
FROM base_data
LEFT JOIN enrichment_data 
    ON base_data.id = enrichment_data.base_id
"""

result_df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)

# Display the first few rows to verify
print("Enriched data preview:")
print(result_df.head())

# Close the connection
conn.close()
